'''''Reekeene's Retribution''''' was the name of a [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|CEC]] [[HT-2200 medium freighter]] used by the [[Reekeene's Roughnecks]], an elite military unit of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], during their campaign against the forces of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Sakai]]. Although the ''Retribution'' succeeded in many attacks against the Empire, it was eventually lost after being infiltrated by the enemy during a raid in the [[Thuris sector/Legends|Thuris sector]].

==History==
[[File:HT-2200_SS.jpg|thumb|left|200px|An example of HT-2200 (not the ''Retribution''.]]
The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] bought this [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|CEC]] [[HT-2200 medium freighter]] c. [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], customized it and assigned it to its elite [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|special forces]] unit, [[Reekeene's Roughnecks]].<ref name="Stock Ships" />

The Roughnecks then used the ''Retribution'' during a campaign against [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Sakai]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] leader of the [[Thuris sector/Legends|Thuris sector]]. The ship survived no less than 1,200 armed attacks against Sakai's forces, and might have seen a part in the destruction of an Imperial orbital [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyard]]. During this time, the ''Retribution'' gained infamy among Imperial officers in the Thuris sector and, to a lesser extent, Imperial officers in general. The Empire had orders to execute the crew of the ''Retribution'' at any available chance, but they were unaware of the crew's identities.<ref name="Stock Ships" />

Eventually, Sakai discovered the names of most of the Roughnecks attacking him. Sakai contacted the [[Special forces/Legends|special forces]] of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] and assigned a special unit, codenamed [[Venom Guard]], to track and execute the Roughnecks.<ref name="Stock Ships" />

The Roughnecks, including the ''Retribution'', then took part in a compound assault against an Imperial fort in Thuris sector. Once the raid was complete, the crew of the ''Retribution'' discovered that they had stowaways in the form of an enemy force. They contacted the rest of their fleet and explained that they were dealing with the problem.<ref name="Stock Ships" />

However, while the rest of the Rebel fleet left the system, the ''Retribution'' never followed. Eventually, the Alliance declared the ''Retribution'' to be lost, probably drifting, and its crew believed to be [[Death/Legends|dead]]. Certain members of the Alliance were worried as the ''Retribution'' hosted hidden [[Datafile/Legends|datafiles]] with secret information about Rebel military operations.<ref name="Stock Ships" />

==Modifications==
The Alliance modified the freighter to use it as a combat ship in military service: The cargo bays were replaced with a medical suite, weapons lockers and a tactical briefing room complete with holotanks and direct communication link to [[Special Forces Command (Rebel Alliance)|SpecForce Command]]. Sublight drives were added to increase the ship's lift/mass ratio. Two retractable missile racks were deployed on articulated wings and loaded with 250 short-range, atmospheric [[FireStorm Air-to-Ground Missile Rack|FireStorms]] each. Lastly, a rear-mounted hatch was deployed to allow commandos to leave the ship while still under the cover of its weapons.<ref name="Stock Ships" />
